messages:
Maya T: Quick heads-up  converting an international contractor (Luca P, UK) to a 0.5 FTE perm role. Proposed FTE salary $220,000 -> prorated $110,000 at 50% FTE. Current S5 top prorated is $105,000, so we're ~5k over. Also proposing one-time retention sign-on $10,000. Target start 2026-09-01 (would prefer earlier but visa/payroll windows may push). What approvals/path?

Ethan B: Candidate accepted verbally, prefers base + one-time cash. Role level IC4 (senior eng). No relocation. Note: cross-region payroll/org code difference — will need UK payroll setup and benefits eligibility check.

Priya - People Ops: Routing checklist: manager justification + org head signoff; comp committee for >$2k prorate; finance for budget + UK payroll chargeback; benefits for part-time eligibility in UK; legal for contractor->employee + UK employment terms; payroll for international onboarding windows. I can open HR ticket once manager justification + org code are pasted here.

Maya T: Manager justification: "Luca owns onboarding infra and will lead cross-team migration next quarter. Conversion avoids knowledge loss and reduces contractor burn. Offer structure: 0.5 FTE base $110k prorated; one-time retention $10k payable after 6 months; no equity. Team budget approved for 0.5 FTE. Will attach CV + migration plan to ticket."

Comp Committee: Flag noted. Committee thresholds: >$2k prorated base variance requires formal exception; >$5k may need VP signoff. Committee meets Fri. Please include benchmarking and market comp docs. Preferences on sign-on being cash vs equity noted.

Ethan B: Confirming candidate accepts 0.5 FTE and cash sign-on. Start flexible: 2026-09-01 preferred, fallback 2026-09-15 if payroll/visa delayed.

Payroll Bot: International payroll cutoff for UK hires to be active on 2026-09-01 is 2026-08-20. If approvals not done by then, earliest active date will be 2026-10-01 due to payroll and legal setup.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks  creating ticket HR-2999998888. Routing to: finance@, comp-committee@, legal@, benefits-uk@, payroll@. Please reply with `+approve` or `-need info`. I'll track visa/payroll SLA.

Legal Ops: Quick legal flag: UK contractor->employee conversion needs written offer with statutory holiday accrual and auto-enrolment pension checks. Also confirm last contractor invoice date to avoid overlap.

Ethan B: Last invoice 2026-08-31; we'll ensure no overlap. Org code ENG-INTL-UK. Attached benchmarking doc in ticket.

Comp Committee: +approve conditional on VP sign-off for >$5k annualized variance. Because this is a prorated base over by ~$5k, we'll escalate to VP People. If VP approves, comp will document exception and sign-off retention pay structure.

Priya - People Ops: Noted. @VP-People please advise on escalation threshold; I'll loop finance/legal for UK specifics. @Ethan please confirm candidate written acceptance of 0.5 FTE + cash sign-on by EOD so we can include in packet.

Maya T: Will get written acceptance today. Thanks everyone :pray:
